_status: Published vendor/reseller specifications (agent research and user-supplied list, 2026-10-07). Applied before measurements.json; any measured value overrides these. Not measurements of the delivered parts.

notes.prop_z: Prop underside ~8.9 mm above frame top (prop seats on the 8.9 mm bell; user research). Prop assembly modelled to 14 mm above frame (prop_z + prop_disk_h) as a conservative envelope.
notes.cam_hfov: MEIVIFPV listing B0DZJTMPHS is a Caddx Ant 1200TVL 1.8 mm (Amazon title). Published FOV for the 1.8 mm lens: ~160 deg horizontal, ~120 deg vertical, 165-170 deg diagonal; the CAD cone uses 160 deg (rotationally symmetric approximation).
notes.bare_aircraft: Component sum excludes antenna, receiver wiring, XT30 lead, screws, heat-shrink and strap; weigh the real aircraft.
notes.thrust: ESTIMATE ONLY (user, revised 2026-10-07): Gemfan 2015 + Specter 1202.5 11000KV on 2S ~70-100 g per motor, ~280-400 g total; plan with 350 g total until bench-tested. Basis: motor reaches 222-226 g/motor on 2S with a 65 mm prop (RCDrone/HGLRC table); HGLRC sells the Petrel 85 whoop with this motor + Gemfan 2015 but publishes no thrust. Earlier 55-75 g/motor estimate withdrawn as too conservative.
notes.stack_h: 12 mm is a reserved allowance, not a published dimension.
notes.stack_w: PROVISIONAL ~33 mm Apex-2 centre-plate width (user research from product photos; no manufacturer drawing). Carrier is slotted, so do not rely on a 33.0 mm fit; measure.
notes.camera: Caddx Ant 1200TVL: 14 x 14 mm body, 19 x 19 mm with included bracket, ~2 g, DC 3.7-18 V, CVBS output, 1/3 in CMOS. Forward position, height and uptilt are mount-dependent: measure.
notes.frame: Amazon B0B25C6XRD (QWinOut APEX-2): wheelbase 95 mm; bottom plate 2.5 mm, upper 1.5 mm, side 1.5 mm; column height 20 mm; FPV camera width 14 mm; 18 g; FC 20x20/25.5x25.5/26.5x26.5; motor 9x9 mm; seller battery 2-6S 200-650 mAh; frame only. Centre-plate width and included screws NOT published.
notes.aio_dampers: Specter AIO on M2 x 6.6 mm damper columns.
notes.rod_dia: 1.00 mm nominal x 400 mm listing value; caliper 2-3 points.
notes.battery_1100: Amazon B0D318NL5W bullets: "Dimension 56.56 x 23.50 x 18.40mm (L*W*H) Approximate Weight:48.00g", Lithium Polymer, 7.6 V nominal, 2S1P, cell range 3.8-4.2 V, 1100 mAh, 60C, XT30, 2 per package; "stop charging ... at 4.2V". Title says "High Voltage" but no LiHV/4.35 V anywhere; charge at 4.2 V/cell. Capacity is 1100 mAh (no 1150 on the page). Cable length not listed.
notes.battery_450: Amazon B0D3F5SQ5T bullets: "Dimension 62.8 x 16.4 x 13.8mm (L*W*H) Approximate Weight:26g", Lithium Polymer, 7.6 V nominal, 2S1P, 100C, XT30, 2 per package; stop charging at 4.2 V/cell. Cable length not listed.
notes.strap: Amazon B01BR2DFV0: Apex RC #3060, nylon, 12.5 mm x 200 mm, 5 pcs. Thickness/weight NOT published.
notes.antenna: Amazon B08M39CG7T (E-outstanding): 5.8 GHz UFL/IPEX dual pack, 70 mm length, 2.15 dBi, 50 ohm (vxb.com listing of same product). Polarisation/weight not found.
notes.pins: Amazon B07V4HPJWD: 304 stainless, centerless ground, diameter 2 mm (+0/-0.0008 in = +0/-0.02 mm), length 16 mm (+-0.02 in), chamfered ends, 0.4 g each; seller advises a hole equal to or slightly smaller than 2 mm for a tight fit. 304 is not hardened: cuttable with an abrasive wheel.
notes.screws: Amazon B0FJ1XLMJT: "VGBUY 840pcs M2 Screw Assortment Kit, M2 x 4/6/8/10/12/16/20mm Hex Socket Head Cap Screws Bolts Nuts Washer Kit, 304 Stainless Steel". Per-size quantities not read. Standard M2 socket head (ISO 4762) 3.8 mm dia x 2 mm; hex nut (ISO 4032) 4 mm across flats x 1.6 mm; flat washer (ISO 7089) 5 x 2.2 x 0.3 mm: standards, not measured.
notes.motor: Amazon B0CHN18RXH: 15.84 x 8.9 mm; 4 x M2 on 9 mm; 4.47 +-0.3 g incl. wire; 80 mm wires, no plug; M1.5 x 4.8 mm shaft; 9N12P; 1-2S; 88 W; includes 2 x M2x7 + 4 x M2x5 screws. Thrust table (HGLRC/rcdrone) has no 2-inch props: Gemfan 65 mm at 7.4 V 100% = 222 g/motor, 9.7 A - an upper reference only; 2015 2-blade will be lower. Measure.
notes.props: Amazon B0DPB4WM4T (Gemfan 2015 sold by MEIVIRC): 2 in, 1.5 in pitch, 2 blades, PC, 0.5 g, 1.5 mm centre hole, 16 pcs (8 CW, 8 CCW). Hub outer diameter/height NOT published: measure.
notes.bearings: Donepart MR52ZZ B07X9T5F81: ABEC-1, 2 mm ID x 5 mm OD x 2.5 mm wide, double shielded, chrome steel, 10 pcs (user research + Amazon listing).
notes.prop_hub: Gemfan 2015 hub ~5 mm OD x 4-5 mm thick PROVISIONAL (comparable 2-inch props; Gemfan does not publish). Collision envelope only.
notes.strap_slot_t: Strap thickness not published; reserve 2 mm (user) -> 2.5 mm slot. Measure.
notes.battery_wiring: Both OVONIC packs: 20 AWG leads, XT30 main, JST-XHR-3P balance (us.ovonicshop per user). Lead lengths NOT published: keep routing flexible; measure.
